project.name: research
project.description: Thesis scaffold for an agentic AI system that analyzes observability data, identifies root causes, and recommends remediation in a Docker Compose Online Boutique SRE environment. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

tour.title: Project purpose
tour.description: Begin with the thesis goals and the separation between upstream Online Boutique and the research scaffold.

tour.title: Runtime foundation
tour.description: See how Docker Compose runs the application and telemetry stack under explicit resource limits.

tour.title: Service and telemetry adapters
tour.description: Learn the boundaries for Docker state and read-only observability access before following a fault run.

tour.title: Controlled faults
tour.description: Read the methodology, scenario validation, and allowlisted Pumba command planning.

tour.title: Experiment lifecycle
tour.description: Follow the CLI into a single controlled fault run and its append-only evidence artifacts.

tour.title: Agent reasoning
tour.description: Trace the RCA session from live evidence through observations, localization, analysis, and recommendations.

tour.title: Guarded remediation
tour.description: Inspect how remediation is reviewed and restricted to allowed operations.

tour.title: Evaluation
tour.description: Study how agent outputs are compared with withheld ground truth across the evaluation tasks.

tour.title: Research dashboard
tour.description: Finish with the web routes and job runner that present scenarios, live progress, and completed results.
